    """Create LIBERO-Plus environment, filtering tasks by perturbation category."""
    from libero.libero import benchmark, get_libero_path
    from libero.libero.envs import OffScreenRenderEnv
    import random

    task_ids = get_tasks_by_perturbation(task_suite_name, perturbation_type)
    if not task_ids:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"No tasks for suite={task_suite_name!r} perturbation={perturbation_type!r}"
        )
    selected = random.choice(task_ids)
    suite_key = f"{task_suite_name}:{perturbation_type}"

    bddl_root = Path(get_libero_path("bddl_files"))
    init_root = Path(get_libero_path("init_states"))

    if isinstance(selected, str):
        # Perturbation task: use BDDL directly, init_states from base task
        task_name = selected
        task_bddl_file = bddl_root / task_suite_name / f"{task_name}.bddl"
        if not task_bddl_file.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Perturbation BDDL missing: {task_bddl_file}")
        base_name = _extract_base_task_name(task_name)
        init_path = init_root / task_suite_name / f"{base_name}.pruned_init"
        if not init_path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Init states missing for base task: {init_path}")
        init_states = torch.load(str(init_path), weights_only=False)
        task_description = base_name.replace("_", " ")
        selected_idx = task_name

        init_path = init_root / task_suite_name / f"{nominal_name}.pruned_init"
        if not task_bddl_file.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Nominal BDDL missing: {task_bddl_file}")
        if not init_path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError(f"Nominal init_states missing: {init_path}")
        init_states = torch.load(str(init_path), weights_only=False)
        task_description = nominal_name.replace("_", " ")
        selected_idx = selected
    else:

        task_description = task.language
        task_bddl_file = (
            Path(get_libero_path("bddl_files")) / task.problem_folder / task.bddl_file
        )
        init_states = suite.get_task_init_states(selected)
        selected_idx = selected

    env = OffScreenRenderEnv(
        bddl_file_name=str(task_bddl_file),
        camera_heights=IMAGE_SIZE,
        camera_widths=IMAGE_SIZE,

    env.seed(seed)
